name: crowdup
description: Crowdfunding website template built using React, Vite, Mantine & Typescript.

paragraphs: An open-source, self-hostable crowdfunding platform for personal projects, charities and NGOs. Organisers publish campaigns and receive donations straight into their own Stripe account; you run the platform on Supabase and Netlify.
Screenshots coming soon. A demo GIF will be added here once a running instance exists.
features: Campaigns: create, edit and publish campaigns with a rich-text story, cover image, goal, end date and category. Browse and filter on the public site. Owners can post plain-text updates and close campaigns.
Donations only: no rewards, perks or equity. Donors can give as guests or signed in, anonymously if they wish. Signed-in donors get a donation history.
Auth: email and password with password reset, optional Google sign-in, via Supabase Auth.
Approval mode: PUBLISHINGMODE=approval holds new campaigns for an administrator to approve or reject. The default auto publishes once the organiser has finished Stripe onboarding.
Abuse reporting: anyone can report a live campaign, with rate limiting.
